note: Key values match browser event.key (uppercase letters, special keys by name).
note_zy: Z and Y are always treated as equivalent — handles QWERTY/QWERTZ confusion.
note_colon: Position uses ':' — on QWERTY: Shift+; — on QWERTZ: Shift+. — both produce event.key ':' so no special handling needed.

contexts.none: No unit selected — show prompt text only
contexts.factory: Show a random T1 factory from the selected faction(s)
contexts.builder: Show a random constructor/builder from the selected faction(s)
contexts.rezbot: Show a Rezbot (ARM: Eraser / COR: Resurrector / LEG: equivalent)
contexts.transport: Show a transport plane from the selected faction(s)

shortcuts.label: Select
shortcuts.description: Left-click a unit — selects just that one, replacing the current selection

shortcuts.label: Deselect
shortcuts.description: Drop the current selection without giving it an order

shortcuts.label: Box Select
shortcuts.description: Left-drag a box — selects every unit inside it

shortcuts.label: Select Commander
shortcuts.description: Jump to and select your commander

shortcuts.label: Select All Units
shortcuts.description: Select every unit on the map

shortcuts.label: Select Idle Builders
shortcuts.description: Select the next idle construction unit

shortcuts.label: Select All Same Type
shortcuts.description: Select every unit of the same type as the currently selected unit

shortcuts.label: Select All Same Type on Screen
shortcuts.description: Select all units of the same type visible on screen

shortcuts.label: Select Damaged
shortcuts.description: Narrow the current selection down to the units below 60% HP

shortcuts.label: Split Army
shortcuts.description: Split the selected group into two halves

shortcuts.label: Select Waiting Units
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Ctrl+Y, QWERTZ: Ctrl+Z (same physical key, Y/Z positions swapped)
shortcuts.description: Select units that are waiting (hold fire etc.)

shortcuts.label: Select Idle Transports
shortcuts.description: Select transport planes/ships that have no orders

shortcuts.label: Move
shortcuts.description: Right-click the ground — the plain move order, units path to the point you clicked

shortcuts.label: Set Target / Attack
shortcuts.description: Right-click an enemy — which of the two you get is configurable in the game settings: Set Target is recommended, Attack is the default

shortcuts.label: Reclaim
shortcuts.description: Right-click a wreck — the selection reclaims it for metal

shortcuts.label: Guard
shortcuts.description: Right-click a friendly unit — the selection follows and assists it, repairing it or helping build whatever it builds

shortcuts.label: Build / Upgrade Mex or Geo
shortcuts.description: Right-click a metal spot or geothermal vent to build the extractor there — right-click your own T1 extractor to upgrade it to T2

shortcuts.label: Queue
shortcuts.description: Shift + right-click — appends the order instead of replacing the queue; keep Shift held to chain several

shortcuts.label: Insert Next
shortcuts.description: Space + right-click — the order jumps to the front of the queue and runs next

shortcuts.label: Move & Assume Formation
shortcuts.description: Alt + right-click a point — units move there and form up with high-HP units in front, all travelling at the speed of the fastest

shortcuts.label: Move in Formation
shortcuts.description: Ctrl + right-click a point — units move there while keeping formation, travelling at the speed of the slowest unit in the selection

shortcuts.label: Attack
shortcuts.description: Press A, then click an enemy to attack it

shortcuts.label: Attack Circle
shortcuts.description: Left-drag a circle to attack all units inside, in priority order (e.g. low health first)

shortcuts.label: Attack Line
shortcuts.description: Right-drag to issue attack orders along points on the line, regardless of unit presence

shortcuts.label: Attack Area
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and drag a circle to attack the entire area, whether units are present or not

shortcuts.label: Target Set
shortcuts.description: Press S, then click an enemy to set it as the priority attack target

shortcuts.label: Target Set Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to set a priority attack target from all enemies in the area

shortcuts.label: Target Set Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt while dragging the target circle to set a priority target restricted to the same unit type as the one at the center

shortcuts.label: Target Cancel
shortcuts.description: Clear the preferred fire target

shortcuts.label: Target: No Ground
shortcuts.description: Set a priority target restricted to actual enemy units or structures — clicks on empty ground are ignored

shortcuts.label: Fight Move
shortcuts.description: Attack-move: units advance while stopping to engage enemies in range

shortcuts.label: Fight Line
shortcuts.description: Drag to deploy units along a line that fight-moves

shortcuts.label: Patrol
shortcuts.description: Make a looping patrol route for selected units

shortcuts.label: Guard
shortcuts.description: Guard a friendly unit or building to help fight, repair, or construct

shortcuts.label: Repeat
shortcuts.description: Repeat currently queued orders

shortcuts.label: Stop
shortcuts.description: Clear all orders and stop the unit

shortcuts.label: Gather Wait
shortcuts.description: Wait at current position until a certain number of units gather

shortcuts.label: On / Off
shortcuts.description: Activate shields, cloak fields and the like

shortcuts.label: Trajectory
shortcuts.description: How artillery and ballistic units arc their shots

shortcuts.label: Fire Stance
shortcuts.description: How units decide when to shoot

shortcuts.label: Move Stance
shortcuts.note: ';' — QWERTY: ; key  QWERTZ: Ö key (same physical position)
shortcuts.description: How far units stray from where you put them

shortcuts.label: Cloak
shortcuts.description: Toggle cloaking on units that support it — one press either way

shortcuts.label: D-Gun
shortcuts.description: Fire the commander's disintegrator gun

shortcuts.label: Capture
shortcuts.description: Capture an enemy unit or structure

shortcuts.label: Show Explosion Radius
shortcuts.description: Hold Space and press X to preview a unit's explosion radius

shortcuts.label: Reclaim
shortcuts.description: Reclaim a wreck or feature for metal

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to reclaim all wrecks and features in the area

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt while dragging the reclaim circle to reclaim only wrecks of the same unit type as the one at the center

shortcuts.label: Repair
shortcuts.description: Repair a friendly unit or structure

shortcuts.label: Repair Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to repair all friendly units and structures in the area

shortcuts.label: Resurrect
shortcuts.description: Click a wreck to resurrect it as a friendly unit

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to resurrect all wrecks within the area

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt while dragging the resurrect circle to resurrect only wrecks of the same unit type as the one at the center

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to order builders to repair all friendlies and reclaim all wrecks in the area

shortcuts.label: Repair & Resurrect Area
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt while dragging the Fight area to repair friendly units and resurrect wrecks within the circle

shortcuts.label: Rotate Building Left
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: [   QWERTZ: ü (same physical key position)
shortcuts.description: Rotate the building placement preview counter-clockwise

shortcuts.label: Rotate Building Right
shortcuts.description: Rotate the building placement preview clockwise

shortcuts.label: Build Spacing +
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Shift+Alt+Z   QWERTZ: Shift+Alt+Y (same physical key)
shortcuts.description: Increase spacing when placing a line or grid of structures

shortcuts.label: Build Spacing −
shortcuts.description: Decrease spacing when placing a line or grid of structures

shortcuts.label: Skip to Next Order
shortcuts.description: Move on to the next order — a build already started is left standing, one not yet begun is dropped

shortcuts.label: Drop Last Order
shortcuts.description: Remove the last order in the queue — the current one carries on

shortcuts.label: Wait
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Y (top row), QWERTZ: Z (same physical position, Y/Z swapped)
shortcuts.description: Pause the unit until further orders — one press flips it back on

shortcuts.label: Self Destruct
shortcuts.description: Order the unit to self-destruct

shortcuts.label: Restore Ground
shortcuts.description: Drag an area to have builders flatten the terrain back to its original shape

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to order builders to repair all friendlies and reclaim all wrecks in the area

shortcuts.label: Area MEX
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: ZZ (bottom-left twice), QWERTZ: YY (same physical position)
shortcuts.description: Place metal extractors on all available spots in a dragged area

shortcuts.label: Area Upgrade Own MEX
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: ZZ, QWERTZ: YY — same keys as Area MEX; Alt+drag to select circle
shortcuts.description: Upgrade T1 metal extractors to T2 in a circle — own mexes only, not allied

shortcuts.label: Cycle Builder
shortcuts.description: With several builders or factories selected, step the build menu to the next one

shortcuts.label: Place Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Place a blueprint for a structure to be built later

shortcuts.label: Next Blueprint
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Alt+]  QWERTZ: Alt++ (same physical key; normalised in trainer)
shortcuts.description: Cycle to the next blueprint in your list

shortcuts.label: Previous Blueprint
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Alt+[  QWERTZ: Alt+ü (same physical key; normalised in trainer)
shortcuts.description: Cycle to the previous blueprint in your list

shortcuts.label: Delete Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Discard the blueprint you are currently holding

shortcuts.label: Factory Guard
shortcuts.description: Whether newly built units stay and guard the factory

shortcuts.label: Show Build Queue
shortcuts.description: Show the factory's current build queue overlay

shortcuts.label: Factory Queue Mode
shortcuts.description: Switch the factory between queue mode and quota mode — one press flips it

shortcuts.label: Load
shortcuts.description: Order the transport to load a specific unit

shortcuts.label: Load Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to load all nearby units into the transport

shortcuts.label: Unload
shortcuts.description: Drop transported units at a target location

shortcuts.label: Unload Area
shortcuts.description: Drag a circle to spread unloaded units across an area

shortcuts.label: Select Group 1
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 1

shortcuts.label: Select Group 2
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 2

shortcuts.label: Select Group 3
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 3

shortcuts.label: Select Group
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to that group — use the number key for the group you want

shortcuts.label: Assign Group 1
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 1

shortcuts.label: Assign Group 2
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 2

shortcuts.label: Assign Group 3
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 3

shortcuts.label: Assign Group
shortcuts.description: Replace current group assignment with all selected units

shortcuts.label: Add to Group 1
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to group 1 without removing existing members

shortcuts.label: Add to Group 2
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to group 2 without removing existing members

shortcuts.label: Add to Group 3
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to group 3 without removing existing members

shortcuts.label: Add to Group
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to a group without replacing its existing members

shortcuts.label: Remove from Group
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Ctrl+`  QWERTZ: Ctrl+^ (same physical key, left of 1)
shortcuts.description: Remove selected units from all their control groups

shortcuts.label: Auto Group 1
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to auto group 1

shortcuts.label: Auto Group 2
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to auto group 2

shortcuts.label: Auto Group 3
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to auto group 3

shortcuts.label: Auto Group
shortcuts.description: Set which group newly built units of this type auto-join — new units of the selected types will auto-assign to that group number

shortcuts.label: Remove from Auto Group
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: Alt+`  QWERTZ: Alt+^ (same physical key, left of 1)
shortcuts.description: Remove the unit types of selected units from their auto group configuration

shortcuts.label: Load Auto Group Preset 1
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 1

shortcuts.label: Load Auto Group Preset 2
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 2

shortcuts.label: Load Auto Group Preset 3
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 3

shortcuts.label: Load Auto Group Preset
shortcuts.description: Recall a saved autogroup configuration — preset 1 is selected automatically at match start

shortcuts.label: Add Group 1 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 1 to what is already selected, instead of replacing it

shortcuts.label: Add Group 2 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 2 to what is already selected, instead of replacing it

shortcuts.label: Add Group 3 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 3 to what is already selected, instead of replacing it

shortcuts.label: Add Group to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add that group to what is already selected, instead of replacing it

shortcuts.label: Toggle Group 1 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 1 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Group 2 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 2 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Group 3 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 3 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Group in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add that group to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Select Camera 1
shortcuts.description: Jump to stored camera position 1

shortcuts.label: Select Camera 2
shortcuts.description: Jump to stored camera position 2

shortcuts.label: Store Camera 1
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to slot 1

shortcuts.label: Store Camera 2
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to slot 2

shortcuts.label: Select Camera
shortcuts.description: Jump to a stored camera position — use the function key for the slot you want

shortcuts.label: Store Camera
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to that slot

shortcuts.label: Map Overview
shortcuts.description: Zoom out to the whole map, then press again or click a spot to jump back in

shortcuts.label: Flip Camera
shortcuts.description: Rotate the camera 180° to look from the opposite direction

shortcuts.label: Show Pathing
shortcuts.description: Toggle pathfinding debug overlay

shortcuts.label: Jump to Last Ping
shortcuts.description: Move the camera to the most recent map marker or message position

shortcuts.label: Metal View
shortcuts.description: Toggle the metal map — shows every extractor spot and how rich it is

shortcuts.label: Map Elevation
shortcuts.description: Toggle the height map, so you can read ridges and valleys at a glance

shortcuts.label: Overhead Camera
shortcuts.description: TA-style camera — straight down on the map, and it does not rotate

shortcuts.label: Spring Camera
shortcuts.description: The free camera — tilts and rotates, the default way to play

shortcuts.label: LOS View
shortcuts.note: The key right of Ö / ; — BAR binds it by position
shortcuts.description: Toggle the line-of-sight overlay, shading everything your units cannot see

shortcuts.label: Show / Hide HUD
shortcuts.description: Hide the whole interface for a clean look at the battlefield — press again to bring it back

shortcuts.label: Track Selection in PiP
shortcuts.description: Lock the picture-in-picture camera onto the units you have selected

shortcuts.label: Swap Camera and PiP
shortcuts.description: Exchange the main camera position with the PiP camera position

shortcuts.label: Copy Camera to PiP
shortcuts.description: Put the main camera's current position into the PiP

shortcuts.label: Chat
shortcuts.description: Open the chat input — Enter again sends the message

shortcuts.label: Chat: Allies ↔ Everyone
shortcuts.description: Toggle the chat target between your allies and everyone

shortcuts.label: Chat: Spectators ↔ Everyone
shortcuts.description: Toggle the chat target between spectators and everyone

shortcuts.label: Chat to Everyone
shortcuts.description: Always addresses everyone, whatever the current target is

shortcuts.label: Mute / Unmute
shortcuts.description: Toggle the game sound — press again to undo an accidental mute

shortcuts.label: Volume Down
shortcuts.description: Turn the game sound down a step

shortcuts.label: Volume Up
shortcuts.note: QWERTY: =  QWERTZ: ´ (same physical key, right of the 0)
shortcuts.description: Turn the game sound up a step

shortcuts.label: Game Speed Down
shortcuts.description: Slow the game down — host and single player only

shortcuts.label: Game Speed Up
shortcuts.description: Speed the game up — host and single player only

shortcuts.label: Unit Info
shortcuts.description: Toggle the stats panel for the unit under the cursor

shortcuts.label: Map Details
shortcuts.description: Toggle the map and game info panel

shortcuts.label: Ping the Map
shortcuts.description: Hold the key and middle-click — drops a marker your allies see and hear

shortcuts.label: Place a Label
shortcuts.description: Hold the key and double-click — opens a text label at that spot

shortcuts.label: Draw on the Map
shortcuts.description: Hold the key and drag — freehand lines for your allies

shortcuts.label: Widget Selector
shortcuts.description: Open the list of UI widgets to switch them on and off

shortcuts.label: Options Menu
shortcuts.description: Open the settings menu

shortcuts.label: Screenshot
shortcuts.description: Save a screenshot to your BAR folder

shortcuts.label: Force Start Vote
shortcuts.description: Call a vote to start the game without waiting for everyone

shortcuts.label: Erase Drawings
shortcuts.description: Hold the key and right-drag — wipes drawings and markers you pass over
